title: lolium rigidum var. strictum
intro: Lolium rigidum var. strictum, commonly known as rigid ryegrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic actions that can help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The health benefits of Lolium rigidum var. strictum include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of various conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
